artifact.sephiria.charm_of_strength.flav: It says "strength" on the tag, and somehow that only makes it less convincing.
screen.sephiria.chest.hint: Click one to take it; the chest is consumed
artifact.sephiria.shield_textbook.flavor: It says: do not show this to young animals.
artifact.sephiria.sword_textbook.flavor: It says: do not show this to young animals.
artifact.sephiria.deft_amulet.flavor: Whoever wears it always tilts their head aside at the last moment.
artifact.sephiria.pinwheel.flavor: Recite the words and it spins, wind or no wind.
artifact.sephiria.specimen_beak.flavor: What a timid bird shows off with.
artifact.sephiria.evergreen_cloak.flavor: Wearing it is like slipping into tree-shade; even the wind loses you.
artifact.sephiria.resistance_band.flavor: Pulling it takes strength; letting go gives it back.
artifact.sephiria.warm_stone.flavor: Kept against the chest long enough, even your fists run hot.
artifact.sephiria.slate_of_rally.flavor: With enough hands, the effort goes one way.
artifact.sephiria.slate_of_wave.flavor: Wave upon wave; even the pull-back carries force.
artifact.sephiria.slate_of_double_star.f: Two stars, one above the other, watching each other.
artifact.sephiria.slate_of_handshake.fla: A shaken hand counts at both ends.
artifact.sephiria.colorless_cube.flavor: A cube with no colour. Stare too long and you start to feel see-through yourself.
artifact.sephiria.silver_plate.flavor: A serving plate, its rim polished bright. What it used to hold, nobody says.
artifact.sephiria.encouragement_banner.f: Wherever it is planted is the line to hold. Nobody slacks off with the flag up.
artifact.sephiria.haste_grimoire.flavor: The pages turn faster than wind; only someone hasted can read the ink.
artifact.sephiria.red_dew.flavor: A drop of red dew on a leaf tip. Blood, or wine.
artifact.sephiria.longing_amulet.flavor: One more hit - that thought aims for you.
artifact.sephiria.fault_probe.flavor: The needle trembles without pause, pointing at the enemy weakest spot.
artifact.sephiria.crittons_seal.flavor: A red seal stamped on the shop's contract. Where it lands, the price is his to name.
artifact.sephiria.lucky_medal.flavor: A lucky charm that looks for fallen leaves on the ground.
artifact.sephiria.golden_maple_leaf.flav: An autumn leaf that refuses to fade; experience settles in its veins.
artifact.sephiria.sword_earring.flavor: A sword and a shield, made into a pair of earrings.
artifact.sephiria.keen_eye.flavor: A grimoire recording the magic of the Keen Eye.
artifact.sephiria.magic_carrot.flavor: A special carrot found once in a while. It never rots, but you can't eat it.
artifact.sephiria.sharp_flint.flavor: Something the village rarely has a use for.
artifact.sephiria.resonance_stone.flavor: It resonates with the strongest elemental power, ringing out crystal clear.
artifact.sephiria.lightning_struck_branc: It has a heavy, peculiar smell.
artifact.sephiria.electric_bug.flavor: A bug that generates electricity on its own. It can be tamed.
artifact.sephiria.qilin_horn.flavor: Wrapped in leather so it will not hurt other animals.
artifact.sephiria.sande_earrings.flavor: Made from new materials developed by the library; it is light.
artifact.sephiria.thunder_verdict.flavor: A book that records the magic of Thunder Verdict.
artifact.sephiria.storm_compass.flavor: An engineering tool built to chase thunderclouds.
artifact.sephiria.firefly.flavor: An insect that gives off cold light. Touching it stings.
artifact.sephiria.typhoon_score.flavor: Feel it: the light that lingers for an instant.
artifact.sephiria.stone_flower.flavor: Flowers exist in the sky, on the ground, and underground.
artifact.sephiria.sapote_fruit.flavor: Chew it when thirsty and you somehow feel much better.
artifact.sephiria.lightning_rod.flavor: It looks like a sword, but it is made of fragile material.
artifact.sephiria.pointy_acorn.flavor: A fruit favoured by the tribe that commands lightning.
artifact.sephiria.thunder_stone.flavor: They found that clashing metal calls down lightning, but it is too dangerous for anyone to use.
artifact.sephiria.cloudseed_arrow.flavor: They say shooting at the clouds brings rain.
artifact.sephiria.mast_model.flavor: When the great flood came, some tried to lash their boats together to survive.
artifact.sephiria.raven_tablet.flavor: The continuity that holds all things.
artifact.sephiria.solis_fracto.flavor: A dagger-shaped badge inefficiently made to please the elves.
artifact.sephiria.solis_parvo.flavor: A dagger-shaped badge granted to the equals of elves.
artifact.sephiria.red_snake_eye.flavor: A gem holding a scorching breath. It points the way even in the dark.
artifact.sephiria.ambergris.flavor: A lump formed from the saliva of a dragon.
artifact.sephiria.red_yarn_ball.flavor: The only entrance, and the only exit.
artifact.sephiria.oak_charcoal.flavor: Wood for the fuel, leaves for the bedding.
artifact.sephiria.fire_bug.flavor: A bug able to set itself alight. It can be tamed.
artifact.sephiria.lava_bead.flavor: A bead holding the breath of magma.
artifact.sephiria.affix.potion_buy_leave: - Generates +%s leaves for every potion bought at the shop
artifact.sephiria.affix.dodge_restore: - Restores %s dash charge(s) when you dodge
artifact.sephiria.affix.crit_splash: - On crit, deal damage equal to %s%% of your highest stat to nearby enemies (range 300)
artifact.sephiria.affix.banner_skill: - Activatable: plant a banner granting allies +%s%% attack speed (range %s, 10s, cooldown 30s)
artifact.sephiria.affix.haste_skill: - Grants the skill "Haste": +15%% attack and movement speed for 24s (cooldown 38s, MP cost %s)
artifact.sephiria.affix.keen_eye_skill: - Grants the skill "Keen Eye": +%s%% crit chance for %ss (cooldown 30s, MP cost %s)
artifact.sephiria.affix.on_hit_lightning: - Damaging a target with a weapon attack or a magic book deals %s extra Lightning Damage (cooldown 2s)
artifact.sephiria.affix.electric_crit: - Crit chance of electric attacks +%s%% (also applies to companion damage)
artifact.sephiria.affix.sande_attack: - Every 4s, hit up to %s nearby enemies with a lightning attack for %s%% of your Lightning Damage and apply Shock
artifact.sephiria.affix.enhanced_shock: - When Shock is applied, %s%% chance to apply Enhanced Shock (immediately trigger one extra Shock damage)
artifact.sephiria.affix.thunder_verdict_: - Grants the skill "Thunder Verdict": fire an 8x8x30 lightning beam along your crosshair that strikes 10 times (per hit 6 + Lightning Damage x %s%%, range 3000, cooldown 25s, MP cost %s)
artifact.sephiria.affix.cloud_speed: - Dark Cloud consumption speed +%s%% of your attack speed
artifact.sephiria.affix.weapon_lightning: - Weapon attacks deal %s extra Lightning Damage
artifact.sephiria.affix.cloud_combat_reg: - Dark Cloud recovery speed in combat +%s%%
artifact.sephiria.affix.cloud_enhanced: - Dark Cloud bolts have a %s%% chance to be empowered (empowered bolts deal double damage)
artifact.sephiria.affix.cloud_free_shot: - Dark Cloud: %s%% chance to cost no capacity
artifact.sephiria.affix.meteor: - Every 5s drops %s meteor(s) nearby, dealing fire damage equal to %s%% of your Fire Element; enemies hit also get the Burn debuff
artifact.sephiria.pressure_bandage.flavo: Wrapped too tight, yet running feels clearer.
artifact.sephiria.golden_cloak.flavor: It billows in the wind, as if about to take off.
artifact.sephiria.wanderer_necklace.flav: Small stones gathered from all over the world.
artifact.sephiria.projection_sword.flavo: Somewhere between No.190 and No.191, one sword is missing.
artifact.sephiria.combo.negotiation.t4: +15 Negotiation, Golden Hands: +1%% damage against enemies per 200 Leaves held (max +20%%)
artifact.sephiria.combo.magic_tech.intro: Electric Touch: dealing lightning damage applies Shock (debuff damage excluded). (Cooldown: 2s)
artifact.sephiria.combo.ember.intro: Flame Touch: dealing fire damage applies Burn (debuff damage excluded). (Cooldown: 2s)
artifact.sephiria.combo.dark_cloud.t10: +20 Dark Cloud Capacity; the cloud fires a double shot
artifact.sephiria.combo.sun_sword.intro: Dealing damage with a weapon or a magic book throws a Sun Sword (fire damage equal to 10% of your Fire Element, no attack interval); the thrown sword drops at the enemy's feet and can be picked back up. Recovers 10% of the count every 0.1s out of combat.
artifact.sephiria.combo.sun_sword.t6: +8% Sun Sword damage, +1 Sun Sword capacity
artifact.sephiria.combo.sun_sword.t8: +10% Sun Sword damage, +2 Sun Sword capacity
artifact.sephiria.combo.sun_sword.t10: +12% Sun Sword damage, +6 Sun Sword capacity
advancement.sephiria.root.title: SEPHIRIA
advancement.sephiria.root.desc: The SEPHIRIA weapon index: how to craft each weapon
advancement.sephiria.recipe.desc: Craft: %s (W = vanilla iron weapon, I = iron ingot, S = any sapling)
potion.sephiria.heal_per_second: Restores %s health per second for %s seconds
artifact.sephiria.warriors_proof.flavor: A badge given to a young lizard after its first hunt.
artifact.sephiria.slate_of_future.flavor: A slate that records what has not happened yet; turn it and the future turns with it.
artifact.sephiria.slate.effect.rotate: Hover the slate and press R to rotate 90 degrees counter-clockwise
artifact.sephiria.slate_of_oath.flavor: Words carved in stone are never forgotten.
artifact.sephiria.slate_of_belief.flavor: As long as you believe, even stone holds up the sky.
artifact.sephiria.slate_of_entrance.flav: The gate is always open, it just never turns.
artifact.sephiria.slate_of_competition.f: Climb on someone else's shadow and the ground below goes missing.
screen.sephiria.enchant.hint: Put in an artifact and press Upgrade to spend one coin
screen.sephiria.artifact_skills.none: (no artifacts with skills in your backpack yet)
screen.sephiria.artifact_skills.hint: Move skills like items: click an icon in the left grid to pick it up, then click a slot on the right to activate it. Click an icon inside a slot to pick it up again and move it elsewhere, or drop it on the left grid to unequip. Right-click a slot to clear it.
screen.sephiria.backpack.subtitle: Artifacts and slates
tooltip.sephiria.tip.label: %s:
tooltip.sephiria.desc.parry: Dash + area damage; a hit taken grants focus
tooltip.sephiria.desc.fury: Spends focus; damages along the dash
tooltip.sephiria.desc.defend: Hold right click to halve damage taken
tooltip.sephiria.desc.shield_sweep: Left click while defending; sweeps around you
tooltip.sephiria.desc.whirlwind: Hold to charge, release at full to dash and cut
tooltip.sephiria.desc.riposte: Two chained stages; a hit taken switches to Riposte 3
tooltip.sephiria.desc.fire: Bolts deal fixed damage and pierce
tooltip.sephiria.desc.reload: Press R to refill the magazine
tooltip.sephiria.desc.toggle: Right click to switch; a hit taken grants intent
tooltip.sephiria.desc.intent: Builds on hits; at full while sheathed it becomes a Powerful Slash
tooltip.sephiria.desc.slash: Cuts around you; damage scales with intent spent
death.attack.sephiria_sun_sword: %1$s was cut down by %2$s Sun Sword
